url.description: Direct Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint (HTTP(S) with host, usually /mcp, not legacy /sse). No embedded credentials or configured auth headers; use configPath+server for headers. Mutually exclusive with configPath/server. Private/loopback hosts allowed, redirects disabled; trust the target before connecting.

configPath.description: Path to an existing MCP JSON configuration, absolute or relative to host project cwd; required with server when url is absent. Configuration may launch local commands with configured environment/cwd or send configured HTTP headers; use only trusted configuration.

server.description: Exact enabled server key from the configuration's mcpServers map; required with configPath, forbidden with url. Discover names with mcp_list using configPath only.

tool.description: Required exact discovered tool name; nonblank, at most 200 UTF-8 bytes (runtime check). Adapter refreshes discovery before calling and rejects names not exposed by the server.

arguments.description: Arguments object forwarded verbatim to the selected tool; defaults to {}. Inspect its discovered schema first and supply its required fields. Adapter checks object type, not conformance to the remote tool schema. Remote execution may have irreversible side effects.

timeoutSeconds.description: Per-request deadline in seconds, 1-300; omission uses configured timeout clamped to 1-300 (configuration default 60), or 60 for direct url. Each initialize/discovery/call request has its own deadline, not one total call budget. Does not override a remote tool's own timeout.
